limits: Reference executes original S_getChannel, S_StopChannel, S_StopSound and S_AdjustSoundParams with controlled channel/speaker stubs. The original priorities/names/enums are compiled independently.
Distance inputs stay inside defined original32-bit arithmetic. The angle/separation calculation is stubbed because only returned audibility is compared; the native PC speaker has one amplitude.
The reference is the pinned released id Software source, including its160-unit close-distance rule. This is not a claim to reproduce every DOS DMX implementation detail.

Channel count is fixed at8. Native origin kinds keep actor/sector/global identifiers separate without storing potentially dangling actor pointers. Actual source ownership validation remains host work.
No actual game event, cache-to-play transition, rendering or browser audio claim follows from these component cases.
